name: @red-cup-engineering/computing
description: Computing — the effective topos Eff = Kl(!): the Cartesian-closed category of COMPUTABLE FUNCTIONS, the MULTI-AGENT (scale-2 / off-diagonal) reading of knowing — knowing's comonad (on one agent's meme, the diagonal) lifted to work over AGENTS. It is multi-agent precisely because animating supplies a full agent to compute over, the way playing is multi-meme (it works over full memes); the lift comes from animating, NOT from the sibling off-diagonal faculties (it depends on none of socializing/gaming/organizing). Built from the Gen-1 quartet plus animating over @red-cup-engineering/relating: playing supplies the *-autonomous CGS (multi-meme) and the ! exponential the Kleisli category is carved from; knowing IS the comonad (accumulating computational evidence is its knowledge order ≤_k); communicating supplies the meme transport a program is; animating supplies the full perceive→act agent a running program is. computing OWNS the Kleisli/Cartesian level — type (an Eff object / assembly over Kleene's first algebra K₁), program (a computable function A→B = a Kleisli morphism !A⊸B), and the settled-truth structure FOUR (verified/refuted/undecidable/contradictory, the image of Ω_Eff under ¬¬, ⊥ forced by Rice). compute runs a program and settles its result to one of FOUR. Carrier type surfaces are checked in with the package source; each action four-faced via induceBins; every call EAVT-witnessed. See dev/docs/notes/2026-06-21-computing-as-effective-topos.md.
